entities.title: Recording format
entities.summary: { ticks, moves }: what the browser sends and the Worker replays.
guarantees: One move [tick, dir, target] per change of control, ticks increasing
target -1 for keys; otherwise a whole pixel from 0 to 480 with dir 0
entities.compatibility: Any change to rules.ts, ai.ts or match.ts changes what a recording replays to. Scores already on the table are not replayed again, and a match in progress during a deploy may be refused.
